text:
In the language of India: <note>original: "rgya gar skad du"</note>

Homage! You are the Virtuous Mother of all the Victors <note>Buddhas</note> of the past, the future, and the present. You are the Goddess, the Daughter of the Victors. You possess the nature of having no inherent nature. I shall speak the name of that Virtuous One who has become the Mother of the Buddhas. Let those who desire prosperity listen!

The Perfection of Wisdom; Omniscience; Knowledge of all aspects of the path <unclear>...</unclear>

<summary>This page contains the opening verses of a Buddhist tantric or philosophical text, offering praise to the Mother of all Buddhas, identified as the personification of the Perfection of Wisdom.</summary>
<keywords>Perfection of Wisdom, Prajnaparamita, Mother of Buddhas, Omniscience, Indian language, homage, emptiness</keywords>
